variables.name: BODY_LIMIT
variables.description: Largest JSON request body express will parse, e.g. "1mb"; nginx client_max_body_size must be at least this

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY_CIDRS
variables.description: Comma-separated trusted proxy IP addresses or CIDRs; empty ignores forwarded headers. Configure only actual proxy peers.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call this API; "*" allows any, empty allows none (same-origin only)

variables.name: CORS_CREDENTIALS
variables.description: Allow cookies and Authorization headers on cross-origin requests (cannot be combined with CORS_ORIGINS=*)

variables.name: HSTS_MAX_AGE
variables.description: Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds; 0 disables the header (browsers only honour it over HTTPS)
